problem_statement: Fix the off-by-one error in the range function. It should return an array from 0 to n-1, but currently returns 0 to n.
initial_code: function range(n) { const arr = []; for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) arr.push(i); return arr; }
expected_code: function range(n) { const arr = []; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) arr.push(i); return arr; }
